name: Performance & Scalability
description: Performance & Scalability standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-BE-PERF applies.

rules.title: Profile endpoint and worker hotspots with production-like data
rules.detail: Measure end-to-end latency and resource use before optimization and identify database/downstream contribution.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Profile endpoint and worker hotspots with production-like data.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Profile endpoint and worker hotspots with production-like data.

rules.title: Use asynchronous I/O for I/O-bound server work
rules.detail: Avoid blocking threads on network/database/file calls in scalable request and worker paths.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use asynchronous I/O for I/O-bound server work.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use asynchronous I/O for I/O-bound server work.

rules.title: Bound request payloads, result sets and parallelism
rules.detail: Set limits for body/file sizes, page sizes, fan-out and concurrent background work.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Bound request payloads, result sets and parallelism.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Bound request payloads, result sets and parallelism.

rules.title: Avoid N+1 and unnecessary materialization
rules.detail: Shape queries/projections to required data and stream or paginate large results rather than materializing unbounded collections.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Avoid N+1 and unnecessary materialization.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Avoid N+1 and unnecessary materialization.

rules.title: Manage pools and caches explicitly
rules.detail: Tune and monitor database/http/thread/cache pools; resource limits must match deployment capacity.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Manage pools and caches explicitly.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Manage pools and caches explicitly.

rules.title: Load test critical paths before material capacity changes
rules.detail: Use representative scenarios and compare p95/p99, throughput, error rate and resource saturation against budgets.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Load test critical paths before material capacity changes.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Load test critical paths before material capacity changes.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-BE-PERF applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Performance & Scalability to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Performance & Scalability is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Performance & Scalability failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
